question_en: Among M, N, O, P and Q, (i) N is taller than only P (ii) O is the second tallest person. M,N,O,P Q (i) N P (ii) O Statements:/ (1) M is taller than N./M,N (2) M, though taller than N, is not as tall as Q. M, N Q (3) Q is taller than N./Q, N (4) O is taller than both M and N. O, M N
option_c: Statement (2) alone or only statements (1) and (3) together
